native_dialog_observation: The first accessibility capture showed Save disabled in the remembered folder. Confirming that same existing folder through Go to Folder enabled Save; PDF saved returned. This does not distinguish initial validation delay from a persistent first-open activation problem.
visual_review: One rendered page directly inspected: both measured values and Korean edit markers are readable, no app chrome or clipping. Plain-prose font ligatures display the literal comment terminator as an arrow; the saved Markdown bytes remain unchanged. PDF text extraction is not a byte-fidelity test.
